name: Nanashiro Mage
source:
Mage is the Secretary of the Student Council in Shikō Academy. 

He starts off as an arrogant and self-centered devil who lives impulsively—and still is pretty impulsive—and used to be quite a sadist.

He can be quite reckless and thoughtless at times.
